mapper.select: SELECT * FROM community_attachments WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND post_id=#{postId} ORDER BY created_at,id
SELECT * FROM community_attachments WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND post_id=#{postId} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM community_attachments WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND post_id=#{postId} AND request_id=#{requestId}

SELECT a.* FROM community_attachments a JOIN community_draft_attachments d ON d.attachment_id=a.id AND d.post_id=a.post_id AND d.owner_id=a.owner_id WHERE a.owner_id=#{ownerId} AND a.post_id=#{postId} ORDER BY d.position

SELECT a.* FROM community_attachments a JOIN community_revision_attachments r ON r.attachment_id=a.id AND r.post_id=a.post_id AND r.owner_id=a.owner_id WHERE a.owner_id=#{ownerId} AND a.post_id=#{postId} AND r.revision_id=#{revisionId} AND a.state='READY' ORDER BY r.position

SELECT a.* FROM community_posts p JOIN community_revision_attachments r ON r.revision_id=p.current_revision_id AND r.post_id=p.id AND r.owner_id=p.owner_id JOIN community_attachments a ON a.id=r.attachment_id AND a.post_id=r.post_id AND a.owner_id=r.owner_id WHERE p.id=#{postId} AND p.status='PUBLISHED' AND p.current_revision_id=#{revisionId} AND a.state='READY' ORDER BY r.position

SELECT a.* FROM community_attachments a WHERE a.owner_id=#{ownerId} AND a.post_id=#{postId} AND a.id=#{id} AND a.state='READY' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_draft_attachments d WHERE d.attachment_id=a.id AND d.owner_id=a.owner_id AND d.post_id=a.post_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_revision_attachments r WHERE r.attachment_id=a.id AND r.owner_id=a.owner_id AND r.post_id=a.post_id))

SELECT a.* FROM community_posts p JOIN community_revision_attachments r ON r.revision_id=p.current_revision_id AND r.post_id=p.id AND r.owner_id=p.owner_id JOIN community_attachments a ON a.id=r.attachment_id AND a.post_id=r.post_id AND a.owner_id=r.owner_id WHERE p.id=#{postId} AND p.status='PUBLISHED' AND a.id=#{id} AND a.state='READY'
mapper.update: UPDATE community_attachments SET state=#{state},safe_failure_code=#{code},result_version=#{version},updated_at=#{now} WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND post_id=#{postId} AND id=#{id} AND state=#{oldState} AND attempt_token=#{token}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM community_draft_attachments WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND post_id=#{postId}
DELETE FROM community_draft_attachments WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND post_id=#{postId} AND attachment_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_draft_attachments WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND post_id=#{postId} AND attachment_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_revision_attachments WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND post_id=#{postId} AND attachment_id=#{id})
